question: How does management describe the revenue outlook for H2 in the Q3 FY2025 report?

input.query: revenue outlook H2 second half FY2025 management discussion

units.label: Quarterly report · 3.3 Revenue commentary
units.breadcrumb: Quarterly report Q3 FY2025 › 3.3 Revenue commentary
units.text:
3.3 Revenue commentary
Revenue rose in each quarter of FY2025. Management expects modest growth in H2, as pricing changes in the payments business annualise and lending volumes stay selective.
Customer complaints fell compared with the prior quarter after changes to dispute handling. Card issuing volumes followed the usual seasonal pattern for the period.
The compliance function completed its annual review of sanctions screening controls. The group continued to simplify its legal entity structure where this reduces operating cost.
The lending business tightened underwriting criteria for unsecured products in selected segments. The group kept its funding mix stable, with customer deposits remaining the primary source of liquidity.

units.text:
3.3 Revenue commentary
Revenue rose in each quarter of FY2024. Management expects modest growth in H2, as pricing changes in the payments business annualise and lending volumes stay selective.
The compliance function completed its annual review of sanctions screening controls. Data platform work concentrated on lineage, so that every reported figure can be traced to its source.
Staff training covered the revised conduct framework and the new incident reporting procedure. Partnership agreements with two payroll providers moved from pilot into general availability.
Operating teams completed the migration of merchant onboarding to the shared identity service. Technology spending shifted from new builds towards reliability work on existing services.

answer.answer: In the Q3 FY2025 Revenue Commentary, management states that revenue rose in each quarter of FY2025 and expects only modest growth in H2, as pricing changes in the payments business annualise and lending volumes remain selective. The preliminary quarterly revenue figures support this cautious tone: Q3 FY2025 came in at USD 4,890M and the preliminary Q4 FY2025 figure stands at USD 5,010M, representing a relatively modest sequential step-up.
